plain_text:
Mine Falls Park Advisory Committee  
Meeting Minutes — November 2, 2026 
Parks Department, 848 West Hollis Street, Nashua, New Hampshire  
Call to Order 
Steve called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. 
Attendance and Guests 
Present: Kamal Masand, Dave Silva, Ben Davis, Sherry Dutzy, Mike Silva, Justin Hoprich, Steve Kenney, Bryan 
Conant, Natalie Lucci, Andrew Lucci, Paula Lochhead, Lon Hochberger, and Kimberly Gryglik.  
Guest: Joseph Peitz (Joe). All committee members listed in the October attendance record were present.  
1. Approval of Previous Meeting Minutes 
• The previous meeting minutes were presented for approval.  
• Motion: Andrew moved to approve the previous meeting minutes. Steven seconded the motion. The minutes 
were approved. 
2. Parks Department Report 
2027 Trail Day and Meeting Calendar 
*October trail day a success- 20-30 volunteers* 
• The committee established the following 2027 Trail Day dates: April 17, May 22, June 19, August 21, September 
18, and October 23. 
• The 2027 committee meeting dates were listed as February 1, March 1, April 5, May 3, June 7, August 2, 
September 7, October 4, November 1, and December 6.  
• The Parks Department will remove the existing Trail Day signs and order updated signs for 2027.  
Gatehouse 
• Members continued discussion of the Gatehouse, including structural engineering concerns and potential 
future work or use. The structural review and related planning remain ongoing; no new formal authorization 
was recorded in the November notes. 
Bridge Projects 
• Members discussed the new bridge anticipated in 2030 and ongoing bridge planning. No new funding decision 
or construction approval was recorded. 
• The Seventh Street Bridge floor redesign, vegetation around bridges, and Mill Pond bridges remained among 
the Parks Department topics. The November notes do not establish a new vote or project assignment on these 
items. 
Cove Trail 
• Reopening Cove Trail was discussed. The committee plans to continue the conversation in December 2026 
and February 2027.
Vegetation and Invasive Bittersweet 
• Members discussed ongoing work to address invasive bittersweet vines growing on trees in the park. 
Continued management remains a maintenance concern.  
Construction Debris Near Stellos Stadium 
• Debris in the water associated with nearby construction at Stellos Stadium was raised. The Parks Department 
will address the debris. 
Park Encampments and Community Safety 
• Steve Kenney reported results of an informal Facebook poll with approximately 130 responses. He stated that 
roughly 90% supported the local ordinance related to unhoused individuals in the park and that approximately 
80–85% felt the park was safer and more usable. 
• These percentages were reported from a Facebook poll and do not represent a scientific or community -wide 
survey. 
3. Committee Topics 
Trail Days — 2027 Project Priorities 
• Members agreed that the committee should develop an actionable, prioritized list of projects and intended 
accomplishments for the 2027 Trail Days. 
• Discussion included volunteer participation, maintenance projects, and identifying achievable work in 
advance of each Trail Day. Specific project assignments remain to be determined.  
E-Bikes and Unauthorized Park Modifications 
• E-bikes and bicycle activity remained active topics, including safety and appropriate use of park trails.  
• Members expressed clear agreement that individuals should not make unauthorized changes to park property 
or trails, including building bicycle jump ramps. Proposed modifications must receive appropriate approval 
before any work takes place. No separate formal motion was recorded. 
Community Partnerships and Possible Park Event 
• Members discussed the value of engaging police, fire personnel, and community partners in a potential Mine 
Falls event to address community concerns and strengthen public involvement. This remains a proposal for 
further planning, not an approved event. 
Other Park Improvement Topics 
• Discussion and handwritten planning notes also referenced bench locations, painting projects, possible 
Gatehouse uses, and other future park improvements. No additional approvals or definite assignments were 
recorded for these concepts. 
4. Action Items and Follow-Up 
Item Status / Next Step 
2027 Trail Days Develop prioritized, actionable project list; committee 
follow-up. 
Trail Day signs Parks Department to remove existing signs and order 
2027 replacements. 
Cove Trail Continue reopening discussion in December 2026 and 
February 2027.
Debris near Stellos Stadium Parks Department to address debris in the water. 
Invasive bittersweet Ongoing vegetation management. 
Unauthorized park modifications Prior approval required; committee position 
discussed. 
Community event Explore participation of police, fire, and community 
partners. 
Gatehouse and bridges Continue pending project discussions; no new 
November approval recorded. 
5. Adjournment 
Kamal moved to adjourn the meeting. Kim seconded the motion. The meeting adjourned at 8:11 p.m.  
Appendix A — Parks Department Backlog 
No separately approved additions to the Parks Department backlog were established in the available November 
meeting notes. Ongoing maintenance and project items are recorded above.  
Draft minutes prepared from the November 2 agenda, handwritten meeting notes, and subsequent clarifications. 
Subject to committee review and approval. 
 
Next meeting- December 7th 2026. 
Kim Gryglik - KG
